notes.notes:
[list]

notes.title: Release Date is Friday, March 4th 2022!
notes.notes: There is a mistake when I set up the release hour, so for some region it will be displayed as March 5th, yet the actual release date is March 4th, which is the next Friday, at around 0~3 am PST. I deeply apologize for this mistake, and please look forward for the game release next Friday!
